data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Single command runs capability + forward-compat + cursor snapshot and exits 0 on success, non-zero with named-step failure

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/pre_cutover.py as CLI entry point. Imports three step functions (capability_check, forward_compat_probe, cursor_snapshot) from sibling modules and runs them sequentially. Each step returns StepResult(name, ok, message, details). Exit 0 when all three pass; exits non-zero with 'FAIL: <step_name> — <message>' on stderr on first failure (short-circuit). Ship stub modules capability_check.py, forward_compat_probe.py, cursor_snapshot.py each returning ok=True stubs. Creates plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/__init__.py if needed.

## TDD Test Spec
Given orchestrator wired to three stubs all returning ok=True; When invoked; Then exits 0 and stdout contains 'OK: pre_cutover (3/3 steps passed)'. Given middle step returns ok=False with name='forward_compat_probe'; Then exits non-zero, stderr contains 'FAIL: forward_compat_probe', and third step is NOT invoked (mock call_count==0).

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Scaffold pre_cutover.py CLI orchestrator with sequential named-step exit-code contract
